title: Integral formula for the Shapley value
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set, and let $i$ be an element of that set. The Shapley value of $f$ at $i$ equals the integral from $0$ to $1$ of its Bernoulli marginal contribution as the inclusion probability varies.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set
$i$ is an element of the underlying $n$-element set
